evidence: The cyclic feeding of the reagents was conducted by specially designed automatic systems of stream breaking with a blinking valve or a rotating disc with slots. Their control systems allowed us to change the duration of the beam from 0.1 to 10 s with simultaneous recording of the number of cycles. The process was conducted in an oil-free vacuum at a residual gas pressure of less than 5 × 10–3 Pa and a substrate temperature in the range TS = 373–623 K.
